provenance.key: Disposable existing test key: 32 bytes each 0x07; never a Home or production key
provenance.note: EIP examples retain their published address; their signatures recover the disposable signer, not that address. They test EIP-191 recovery. The original phone vector retains a retired account-creation message for recovery checks only. The phone-signin vector uses the Runtime resource scheme and tests the complete Home sign-in proof.
